text:
Maya Chen: 🎉 Quick shout — we just crossed 10M monthly requests!!! Absolute wild. How do we celebrate? in-person + remote peeps included pls 

Devon Patel: OMG YESSSSS :tada: can we get cold brew + bagels? 

Samira Torres: corgi confetti pls. also +1 on remote swag drops (socks or stickers) 

Kai Nguyen: tiny poll: (1) cold brew + bagels, (2) corgi confetti & tiny plushies, (3) pizza + karaoke. Vote with emoji! 

Liam O'Connor: i vote :coffee:  — can we do cake too? lowkey want a small plaque for the queue team :smile: 

Jules: remote people — would you prefer a $15 gift card or a care package? @Samira can you run a quick form? 

Samira Torres: sure — i'll drop a 2-question form in #random in 5. remote = gift card or care package. in-person = food prefs. 

ops-bot: Kitchen reservation created by @Maya Chen for 2026-04-02 15:00 — Location: 3rd floor kitchen. Chairs: 12. 

Devon Patel: budget? i'll submit an expense request. if anyone needs receipts, ping me. 

Maya Chen: budget ~ $180 for food + swag. Liam can you approve? @Liam O'Connor 

Liam O'Connor: approved. submitting PO now. 

Devon Patel: PO submitted: `PO-48219` — catering on the morning of. 

Jules: tiny idea — let's do a 60s 'how we got here' slideshow, 3-4 slides max. keeps it short and hype. who wants a slide? 

Kai Nguyen: i'll do one slide on autoscaling wins and funny graphs :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

Maya Chen: perfect. Samira, can you coordinate remote swag drop addresses? 

Samira Torres: on it. will DM addresses and timeline. 

Devon Patel: also — corgi confetti or confetti canon? i feel like confetti canon might be chaotic in an open office :grimacing: 

Jules: tiny indoor-safe confetti poppers. corgi stickers. 

Maya Chen: love it. big thank you to everyone who shipped the rollout — this is such a team win. :sparkles: :heart: 

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Celebration in 6 days at 15:00. RSVP posted in #random. 

Devon Patel: RSVP'd ✅ can't wait to see corgi stickers all over the kitchen 

Kai Nguyen: gif: :party_parrot: 

Maya Chen: closing note — if anyone wants to shout out a teammate in the slides, reply here with name + 1 line before EOD. 

Liam O'Connor: shoutout to @Devon for wrangling the PO, and @Kai for smoothing the autoscale spikes — legends. 

Samira Torres: shoutout to infra & queue teams. and coffee champions. 

Jules: shoutout to Maya for rallying the slides and logistics — thank you! :clap:
